result.topic_en: Completion of a derivation of the Lagrange inversion series, expressing a function of x (where x = t + u·ψ(x)) as a power series in u with successive derivatives, dated 13 May 1847.
result.transcription:
276
$\Theta_1 = (\psi t)^2 . Ft$
Hienach wird ferner
$T_2 = \frac{1}{2} . \frac{d.(\psi t)^2 Ft}{dt}$
und dann abermals, Kraft der obigen Bemerkung,
$\Theta_2 = \frac{1}{2} . \frac{d(\psi t)^3 . Ft}{dt}$
Sodann
$T_3 = \frac{1}{2.3} . \frac{dd(\psi t)^3 Ft}{dt^2}$
$\Theta_3 = \frac{1}{2.3} . \frac{dd(\psi t)^4 Ft}{dt^2}$
$T_4 = \frac{1}{2.3.4} . \frac{d^3(\psi t)^4 Ft}{dt^3}$
u.s.w.
Als Endresultat haben wir also
$fx = ft + \psi t . \frac{dft}{dt} . u + \frac{1}{2} . \frac{d\, \psi t^2 . \frac{dft}{dt}}{dt} uu$
$+ \frac{1}{2.3} \frac{dd(\psi t)^3 . \frac{dft}{dt}}{dt^2} u^3 + \frac{1}{2.3.4} \frac{d^3(\psi t)^4 \frac{dft}{dt}}{dt^3} . u^4$ + u.s.w.
welches der Lagrangische Lehrsatz in seiner ganzen Allgemeinheit ist
1847 Mai 13.

methods.what: Recursive determination of the series coefficients T_n, Θ_n via derivatives of powers of ψ(t) times F(t)
General n-th coefficient pattern: T_n = 1/n! · d^{n-1}[(ψt)^n Ft]/dt^{n-1}
Lagrange inversion theorem: series expansion of f(x) in powers of u, where x = t + uψ(x)
